descriptions.zh:
我们完成了指令。

子个体在规定参数范围内满足了生产配额。

我们需要执行库存的最终指令。
descriptions.en:
We have accomplished the directive.

The drones met the production output within the prescribed parameters.

We require the final input for stockpile utilization.

tooltips.zh: 把这些商品储存起来，作为我们高效生产方式的证明。
tooltips.en: We shall store the commodities as evidence of our efficient production methods.

label.zh: 我们会将其在公共市场上出售。
label.en: We will sell it on the public market.

tooltips.zh: 我们将启动市场开拓以推销我们的产品。
tooltips.en: We shall initiate a market exploration to disseminate our commodities.

tooltips.zh: 我们将探索外交渠道以交换商品。
tooltips.en: We will explore diplomatic channels to exchange our commodities.

tooltips.zh: 我们会寻找私人卖家用库存交换有价值的科技洞见。
tooltips.en: We will seek a private buyer to exchange the stockpile for valuable technological insights.

label.en: Place them in a black hole.

tooltips.zh: 我们会把它们安全地储藏在黑洞的事件视界之内。
tooltips.en: We will store them safely beyond the event horizon of a black hole.

descriptions.zh:
我们未能在该周期内完成生产指标。

该情况会降低我们子个体的产出直到能完成生产目标为止。

后续的生产配额已降低。
descriptions.en:
We have failed to meet our production targets this cycle.

This scenario will reduce our drone output until we achieve a production goal.

The subsequent production quota has been reduced.

tooltips.zh: 过量的£consumer_goods£ §Y消费品§!会被堆砌进§Y[capital_star.GetName]§!，造成一个剩余£consumer_goods£§Y1000§!的库存。
tooltips.en: Excess £consumer_goods£ §YConsumer Goods§! will be jettisoned into §Y[capital_star.GetName]§!, resulting in a stockpile of £consumer_goods£ §Y1000§! remaining.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]中大部分虚拟人口已经突破我们的防火墙，以一连串的数据和乱码的方式从我们手上逃脱。
descriptions.en: The mostly virtual population of [Root.GetName] has broken through our firewalls and escaped from our grasp in a burst of data and nonsense code.
